name: FileTransferChannels
description: TauSync meeting-word identifiers for the file transfer protocol. Both PC and Android must call tau.connect() with the exact same string — define it here once and generate both sides.

members.name: REGULAR_FILE_METADATA_PC_TO_ANDROID
members.description: PC sends file metadata when PC initiates a file transfer to Android.

members.name: REGULAR_FILE_METADATA_ANDROID_TO_PC
members.description: Android sends file metadata when Android initiates a file transfer to PC.

members.name: REGULAR_FILE_DATA_PC_TO_ANDROID
members.description: PC streams raw file bytes when PC initiates a file transfer to Android.

members.name: REGULAR_FILE_DATA_ANDROID_TO_PC
members.description: Android streams raw file bytes when Android initiates a file transfer to PC.

members.name: REGULAR_FILE_RESPONSE_FROM_ANDROID
members.description: Android writes ACCEPTED or REJECTED response when PC initiates a file transfer.

members.name: REGULAR_FILE_RESPONSE_FROM_PC
members.description: PC writes ACCEPTED or REJECTED response when Android initiates a file transfer.
